ProjectsThe Light House

05Hospitality Design

THE LIGHTHOUSE

Category
Hospitality
Location
Tulum, Mexico
Year
2023
Area
3,200 m²

AOverview

A retreat where the pools, pavilions and the light itself are the main attractions.

The Light House is a 24-key boutique retreat on the Caribbean coast. Low timber pavilions drift around a long reflecting pool, so guests move between water, shade and sky rather than corridors and lobbies.

BDesign Concept

THE BIGIDEA.

We designed the property as a day in light: sunrise yoga deck, shaded noon loggia, golden-hour bar, lantern-lit dinners. Every pavilion faces the pool so the whole resort glows after dark.

Fig. 02 — Thatched lounge pavilion beside a turquoise pool

C

The challenge

The coastal site faces salt, humidity and hurricane-force winds, and the owners wanted an airy, open feel with minimal air-conditioning.

A

Our approach

Elevated structures, raised decks and deep thatched roofs ensure cross-breezes. Materials are marine-grade and locally sourced, and lighting is low, warm and shielded to protect the night sky.
